mechanism: Both drugs are topical antifungals with different mechanisms (terbinafine inhibits squalene epoxidase; clotrimazole inhibits lanosterol 14α-demethylase), and concurrent use may reduce efficacy or create redundancy depending on route and indication.
action: Avoid concurrent topical application to the same area; if systemic terbinafine is used concurrently with topical clotrimazole, monitor treatment response and consider using only one agent to prevent antagonism.
